title: Established Specialist Relationship Allowance — Primary Care Provider Assignment
content:
**Training note, Primary Care Provider Assignment: the relationship allowance on a carried specialist referral, in questions and answers.**

**What is the relationship allowance?**
When a single referral issued under a member's earlier primary care assignment is carried onto the member's current assignment, relationship visits are added for an established specialist relationship. They are added to the visits left on the carried referral, before the single-referral visit ceiling is applied to the carried visits.

**How is the relationship measured?**
It is counted as the referrals the earlier assignment issued to the referred specialist — the specialist named on the carried referral — with an issue date in the relationship window of **12 months**. The window is a trailing period counted back from the handling date in whole months: a referral is inside it when fewer than 12 whole months separate its issue date from the handling date, so a referral issued exactly 12 months back is outside it.

**How many visits does it add?**

| Referrals from the earlier assignment to the referred specialist in the 12-month window | Relationship visits added |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 2 (the two-visit relationship allowance) |
| Exactly 2 | 1 (the one-visit relationship allowance) |
| Fewer than 2 | 0 |

**Which referrals are counted?**
Only those issued by the earlier assignment, only those naming the referred specialist, and only those issued inside the 12-month window. Referrals to other specialists do not count.

**Worked answers (hypothetical histories, handling date 15 September 2026)**

- The earlier assignment issued referrals to the referred specialist on 1 February 2026, 3 May 2026 and 20 July 2026: three in the window, 2 relationship visits.
- Referrals on 15 September 2025 and 3 May 2026: the first is exactly 12 months back and outside the window, leaving one, so 0 relationship visits.
- Referrals on 16 September 2025 and 3 May 2026: both inside, exactly two, so 1 relationship visit.
